name: Buddhabrot
desc: A ghostly Buddhabrot apparition — the accumulated escape trajectories of the Mandelbrot iteration paint a luminous, slowly-breathing nebula of blue-cyan-gold density on deep space, also rendering as blackbody ember, escape-count spectral rainbow, violet ghost, or bone-white monochrome.

energy.doc: exposure / glow amplitude (log gain) — brighter, more filled at max

scale.doc: zoom into the phantom (higher = bigger, fills/overspills frame)

persist.doc: density-buffer decay — 0 crisp/live, 1 long luminous smear

hue.doc: palette base hue (rotates the whole scheme)
